paragraphs.text: A /context slash command for DeepSeek Harness: context window usage, free space, and a per-category
breakdown of what fills the prompt.
# dsh-command-context
English | 中文

A `/context` slash command for **DeepSeek Harness**: type it in a session to see how much
of the con

text window is used, how much is free, and which part of the prompt takes the
most room.

Inspired by Claude Code's `/context`, but every number comes from the harness's own
measurement inst
ead of a parallel accounting of its own.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`/context top [N]` appends the largest surface nodes — the answer to "what is actually
eating my con
text" (`/context 3` is accepted as a shorthand for `top 3`):
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Tool results are named by the tool that produced them (resolved from `tool/call`), so a
single overs
ized output is visible at a glance. `N` defaults to 5 and is capped at 20.

Illustrative numbers. `measured` means the headline figure came from reusable provider
usage; `estim
ated` means it fell back to the character heuristic.
## Languages

The report is bilingual and **Chinese is the default**; `/context en` switches to English
(`/context
zh` switches back). Both render identical numbers — only the wording changes:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Column padding follows **display width** (a CJK glyph counts as two cells), so the numeric
columns l
ine up in either language.

The card renders **expanded by default**. A command result normally lands in the generic
collapsed c

ard that needs a click to open; this plugin's client half takes over the keyed
client slot `conversa

tion.chat.commandview` for the `context` command only, so the report
is simply visible. Every other

command keeps the built-in card. In a composition without a
chat UI the host half still works and th
e generic card is used.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Or install it from the plugin directory. The bundle is Host-only — no client half, no
extra services

t from the plugin directory. The bundle is Host-only — no client half, no
extra services to compose:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Requires `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `>=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0-0`. The command is registered globally,
so it is av
ailable in every agent of that profile.
## How categories are decided

Classification is **per surface node**, not by slicing text: every surface node already
carries its
own token price, so the command only has to decide which bucket it belongs to.
| Event | Bucket |

| `system/message` | `System prompt` |
| `user/message` whose blocks are all `<system-reminder>` and

mention `workspace instructions` / `Instructions from:` / `memory root:` | `Memory files` |
| `user
/message` whose blocks are all `<system-reminder>` and mention `skills are available` / `<available_

skills>` | `Skills` |
| `user/message`, any other `<system-reminder>` injection | `Injected context`

|
| `user/message`, real input | `User messages` |
| `developer/message` | `Injected context` |
| `

assistant/message` | `Assistant replies` |
| `tool/result` | `Tool results` |
| `tool/result` whose
tool name starts with `mcp__` | `MCP` |

The part that matters: **an instruction file (e.g. `AGENTS.md`) and the skills catalog each
arrive a

s their own `user/message`** whose only block is a `<system-reminder>` — they are
neither part of th

e system prompt nor something the user typed. Leaving them in
`User messages` inflates that line bad

ly, which is exactly what the first version of this
plugin got wrong.

The split is deliberately conservative: if a message contains even one block that is not a
`<system-

reminder>`, the whole message stays under `User messages`. Under-splitting beats
misattributing text
the user actually wrote.
## Where the numbers come from
| Figure | Source |
| Used / pressure | `ctx.tokenMeter.measure(session).totalTokens` — replays the durable session log,

no model call |
| Context capacity | `session.requestContext().contextWindow` (the `request/context

` record) |
| Free space | capacity − pressure |
| Breakdown | `measure().nodes`, classified per nod

| Free space | capacity − pressure |
| Breakdown | `measure().nodes`, classified per node |
[该节后续省略]
## Why the report avoids block characters

A command result renders inside a `<pre>` with `white-space: pre-wrap` and a monospace font.
Block c

haracters such as `█░` are taller than the line box and visually collide with the
neighbouring lines

in that container, so the meter uses `#`/`-` instead. Column alignment is
computed from display wid

th rather than string length, which is what makes the Chinese labels
line up with the numbers.

The command's description in the slash panel is Chinese (`查看当前会话的上下文窗口占用`) to
match built-in command

s in a Chinese UI. Plugin Manager metadata ships in both languages via
`locale/en.json` and `locale/

inese UI. Plugin Manager metadata ships in both languages via
`locale/en.json` and `locale/zh.json`.
## Limitations

- **An estimate, not a bill.** The headline is measured only when reusable provider usage
exists. Th

e itemized rows are route pricing / heuristic, so they are a different scale
from the headline; `Una

ccounted` is that difference, not a category and not a mistake.
When the headline itself is heuristi

c (no reusable provider usage) the table sums exactly
and `Unaccounted` disappears.
- **`Tool defini

tions` comes from a different estimator than the rows above it.** It is
`toolsTokens` from the `cont

extBreakdown` projection (the harness's own tool-schema
pricing) rather than a per-message route pri

ce. When that projection is unavailable the
row is omitted rather than estimated separately, and its

share moves into `Unaccounted`.
- **The definitions part of `MCP` is allocated, not measured.** Too

l schemas are only known as
one `toolsTokens` total, so the MCP share of it is split by declared sch

ema size; the MCP
*results* part is real per-node pricing. When a session sends no `mcp__*` tool the

row is
absent.
- **`Compaction trigger` is labelled `(default policy)` unless the backend's own pol

icy was
reachable.** Either way it does not assert that automatic compaction is enabled in your
comp

osition; with no compaction backend reachable the line is omitted entirely.
- **No capacity, no perc

entage.** A session with no `request/context` record yet reports the
used tokens and says plainly th

at it cannot compute a ratio.
- Covers the current session only; subagent sessions are not included.
